items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Joe Glaser had booked us in there, and for business reasons Joe had turned everything over to me

ctx.x: Yeah, we were in Moline, Illinois. I'm trying to think of the club we were working. And it was a very nice club, too. And I was there -- at that particular time Joe Glaser had booked us in there, and for business reasons Joe had turned everything over to me, and asked me to take charge of the business of collecting the money, paying the band off, including Stuff, and whatnot, because Stuff was such a generous (Laughs) -- he would give the money, my money, anybody else's money, because he was every night, give me…

We knew he'd keep that up, you know, and the next night he may say give me three hundred, two hundred, well when payday comes there's nothing left. You know. And he didn't realize it was accounted -- anyway, I had charge of the monies, and so Stuff -- I think that helped to make him feel worse, so -- and he -- one of the night -- that time he was drinking rum and Coke, and he would have quite, quite,
